NONE: › to make a record or film available for people to buy or see for a second time

C or U: › [ C or U ] the act of rereleasing music or a film
C: › [ C ] music or video that has been rereleased

example: There are plans to rerelease all the band's albums online.
有計劃在網路上重新發行樂隊的所有專輯。
I went to see the rerelease of "The Jungle Book".
我去看了迪士尼電影《森林王子》的再發行本。

NONE: › to change the route of something
改變…的路線；給…重定路線

example: The plan entails rerouting traffic through a tunnel to create a vast pedestrian area.
這項規劃需要改變交通路線，使其通過一條隧道，從而開闢出一大片步行區。

NONE: › to show a television programme, film, etc. again

C: › [ C ] a programme or film that has already been shown before on television
重播（的節目）；重放（的影片）
C usually singular: › [ C usually singular ] UK something that happens or is done again
重現（的事情）；重新舉行（的事）

example: The James Bond movies are always being rerun on television.
電視上總是重播007系列電影。
This week's movies are all reruns.
這週上映的電影都是重放的片子。
The Party is demanding a rerun of the poll.
該党要求重新舉行選舉。
